# Kraftzen

> An AI studio in Delhi, India. We build AI tools, workflow automation, websites
> and automated content systems for small teams. Two of our own products are live
> in public. Clients get a fixed quote, a date, and full ownership of the code.

Contact: officialkraftzen@gmail.com · +91 9310367672
Founder: Garvish Dua

## Services

- **AI tools and agents** — task specific tools and agents built around one job a team repeats. https://kraftzen.in/services#ai-tools-and-agents
- **Workflow automation** — pipelines that move work between existing tools, with error handling and a readable run log. https://kraftzen.in/services#workflow-automation
- **Websites and web apps** — marketing sites, product sites and landing pages in React or WordPress, with technical SEO built in. https://kraftzen.in/services#websites-and-web-apps
- **Automated content systems** — automated blog engines on your own domain, with research, drafting, internal linking and indexing handled. https://kraftzen.in/services#automated-content-systems

## Products

Kraftzen has exactly two products of its own. Both are live.

- **Bro AI** — five narrow AI tools behind one login: Designer Bro (visuals, headshots
  and thumbnails from a brief), Gen-Z Bro (photos rendered in whatever art style is
  trending, Ghibli and after), Animator Bro (motion from a static design), Portfolio
  Bro (portfolio sites), Emailer Bro (campaign copy and sequences). https://bro.ai.in
- **AniVerseX** — a blog that runs itself: topic research, drafting, internal linking
  and indexing, with no person in the loop unless you want one. The same system is
  what we rebuild for clients. https://aniblogs.vercel.app

## How engagements work

1. Send an enquiry. We reply within one business day.
2. A 30 minute call to understand the actual work.
3. A fixed price and a date, in writing.
4. We build, hand over the code and accounts, and walk you through it.

Engagement shapes:

- **Sprint** — 1 to 2 weeks. One scoped deliverable.
- **Build** — 3 to 8 weeks. A custom tool, content system or full site.
- **Ongoing** — monthly, cancel anytime. We keep running and extending what we built.

Pricing is quoted per project after one call. No published rate card.

We work with clients outside India. Clients own the code, the accounts and the
documentation at the end of every project.
